description: Read-only search of everything saved in earlier sessions. Call it BEFORE answering anything about the user, their projects, preferences, decisions or past work: the answer is usually stored. One row per neuron: the best entry (matching_content; entry_id → crbro_inspect view=neuron entries=[id] reads it whole), confidence (weak: verify; a search match, not truth) and also_matched previews. Absent fields hold their default: temporal current_claim, verification none (present = a check the caller reported), freshness unverified, provenance local. Lines not the user's own carry origin, also_matched too: team:<space> with self-declared by, or miner. Rows past their shelf life move to possibly_stale as last_known with a next_step: check before answering with one. has_map: read crbro_map before touching that system.

domain.description: Only neurons of this exact domain.

intent.description: current splits historical records into historical_matches; history keeps only them; any (default).

kind.description: Only these entry kinds, e.g. ["error"] before repeating a mistake. Leaves out day logs.

neurons.description: Only these neuron ids; no day logs.

project.description: Project id or alias; default the boot project of this connection.

queries.description: Other phrasings searched with query and fused: synonyms, the other language, product names. 2-4.

query.description: What to look for; a few distinctive terms beat a sentence.

scope.description: auto (default) ranks the bound project first; project restricts to it; all ignores it.

since.description: A day ("2026-09-01") or span ("7d", "2w", "3m"); undated entries are skipped and counted.

name: crbro_recall

no_answer.description: Nothing cleared the evidence bar: at most 3 weak rows, the nearest

semantic.description: warming: model still loading, keyword-only answer
